def VTask.evenOddRec {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} (h0 : P 0) (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) (n : ℕ) : P n :=
  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), P n := by
    intro n
    -- Use strong induction on n to define P n
    have h : ∀ (n : ℕ), P n := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        -- Base case: n = 0
        cases n with
        | zero =>
          exact h0
        | succ n =>
          -- Inductive step: n = k + 1
          have h₁ : (n + 1) / 2 < n + 1 := by
            have h₂ : (n + 1) / 2 ≤ n := by
              omega
            omega
          -- Consider the cases where n is even or odd
          have h₂ : P ((n + 1) / 2) := ih ((n + 1) / 2) h₁
          -- Determine if n is even or odd
          have h₃ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
          cases h₃ with
          | inl h₃ =>
            -- Case: n is even
            have h₄ : 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) = n + 1 := by
              have h₅ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := h₃
              have h₆ : 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) = n + 1 := by
                omega
              exact h₆
            have h₅ : P (n + 1) := h_even ((n + 1) / 2) h₂
            simpa [h₄] using h₅
          | inr h₃ =>
            -- Case: n is odd
            have h₄ : 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) + 1 = n + 1 := by
              have h₅ : (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := h₃
              have h₆ : 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) + 1 = n + 1 := by
                omega
              exact h₆
            have h₅ : P (n + 1) := h_odd ((n + 1) / 2) h₂
            simpa [h₄] using h₅
    exact h n
  exact h_main n
